revision: S5 placement, R4 routed carrier: Bread Modular 8bit for Eurorack, 4HP
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Single hole pair at X12.58: the Doepfer 4HP X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py) moved 1HP (5.08 mm) right, as modules/midi. The repository skiff rails are 10 mm wide centred on Y3.0/Y125.5, leaving the clear Y8.0..120.5 (112.5 mm) gap; commercial rails differ, so the PCB keeps 1.25 mm margin and the 16-pin IDC socket envelope stays inside the gap.

main_pcb.note: 19.0 x 110.0 mm (as modules/midi), 1.25 mm inside the skiff rail gap at each end; held by the three jack bushings/nuts. The pots have no bushing or nut (user stock, as modules/audio-out): they are soldered only.

jack_rotation_note: As modules/midi: T/TN/S pads run along X with the S (sleeve) pad toward the left board edge; jack bodies are 9.0 mm along Y.
pot_note: Bread Modular RV09 footprint (pins 7.5 mm below the shaft on 2.5 mm pitch, bracket tabs 9.6 mm apart on the shaft line). User stock pots, as modules/audio-out: no threaded bushing, no nut, 16 mm knurled shaft above the body; 3D proxy hardware/8BIT.3dshapes/RV09_proxy.step (from audio-out). pot_shaft_offset_mm = shaft centre relative to the footprint origin at rotation 0. Rotation 0: pins below the shaft, pin 1 on the left (front view), so CW turns the wiper toward pin 3.

button.part: Generic 6 x 6 mm THT tact switch, 4 pins, 7 mm tall (body 3.1 mm, tapered round stem 3.9 mm, Ø3.4 to Ø3.2), pins 6.5 x 4.5 mm, 0.7 mm legs; pins 1-2 and 3-4 are joined inside (along the 6.5 mm side)
button.note: THT on the carrier F side (faces the panel), hand-soldered; the legs come through to B. Stock KiCad SW_PUSH_6mm_H7.3mm (copper identical to every SW_PUSH_6mm variant; the 7.3 mm model is the closest stock height). Placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre. Rotated 180: pad 1 (BUTTON) on the bottom row (Y89.25), pad 2 (GND) on the top row (Y84.75). The panel rear is 3.0 mm above the stem top; a one-piece printed cap (panels/button-actuator) bridges it.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.led_note: 3 mm LED body (flange to dome) is 5.3 mm; body bottom at Z6.3 puts the dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front (Z11.6) and 0.4 mm recessed in the 2.0 mm print. The stock KiCad LED_D3.0mm model already stands its flange at Z3.0, so the board model offset is +3.3 mm.
stack_Z_mm.source: Slices of the Bread Modular AudioJacks STEP models (PJ301M-12.step, PJ366ST.step); the library marks them 'Untested', so measure real jacks before committing the LED stand-off.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: User RV09 (as modules/audio-out): body 6.8 mm nominal, 1 mm collar, shaft to Z22.8 (11.2 mm past the FR4 front). No bushing, no nut. Measure a real pot before ordering panels.
stack_Z_mm.switch_note: Measured SW1: 7.0 mm tall, body 3.1 mm, tapered stem 3.9 mm (Ø3.4 at the body to Ø3.2 at the top). switch_stem_D is the mean stem diameter in the socket grip zone (Z4.5..7.0: Ø3.33..3.2).

power_header.orientation: Vertical (pin rows along Y). Pin 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom row Y116.0, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top row Y105.84.
power_header.idc_note: Eurorack 16-pin cables plug onto a 10-pin header aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V): socket positions 11-16 (+5 V, CV, Gate) overhang past the +12 V end. With pin 1 at the bottom the overhang runs up over the board, never past the board edge. Envelope = 2x8 IDC socket that fits a box header (25.4 x 6.4 mm body + ~1.2 mm key bump), 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres. The envelope bottom (Y119.81) stays inside the rail clear gap (Y120.5), so the plug never relies on rail depth. A 10-pin socket uses the lower part of the same envelope.

cap.note: one piece, printed socket-down; press-fits over the switch stem, its flange is held behind the panel, its tip passes the panel hole

button_actuator.travel_note: Switch travel ~0.25 mm. Flange 1.4 mm above the switch body, 1.5 mm below the panel rear (the 0.3 mm of rev 1 let the panel press the flange and hold the switch on); tip 1.9 mm (FR4 front Z11.6) / 1.5 mm (print front Z12.0) proud of the panel.
